name: SuperTuxKart 1.5
notes: Antarctica (STK's Irrlicht fork). In its Direct3D 9 mode (--render-driver=directx9) it runs through wined3d's Vulkan renderer, MoltenVK in the plain Wine tree; wined3d's default OpenGL renderer gets no pixel format on Macs without hardware OpenGL. Without d3dx9_43.dll it falls back to the fixed pipeline on Windows and on Wine alike ('Could not load shader function D3DXAssembleShader'). DXVK-macOS's d3d9 cannot make a device on the runner (MoltenVK lacks geometryShader and shaderCullDistance). MVK_CONFIG_USE_MTLHEAP=0 keeps MoltenVK from placing buffers in Metal heaps: with heaps (its default), about one second in every ten of the main menu is drawn with broken transforms on the runner, the menu squashed into slivers over the clear colour, which failed the scenario about one run in ten; without heaps no frame was broken. PROGRESS.md, 'SuperTuxKart's broken frames'. Found by the game survey (docs/games.md).
